title: Groom Club Monthly: Notice Given and the Club Late-Cancellation Charge
content:
**Groom Club Monthly at the Tailwise Grooming Salon — notice and the club late-cancellation charge.**

The notice treatment of the club late-cancellation charge follows the full hours of notice recorded on the cancellation — the most recently recorded cancellation on the club with a fee remedy:

- notice of at least half (0.5) of the club's free-cancellation notice prorates the club visit value by the share of the free-cancellation notice that was not given, that is the visit value multiplied by the free-cancellation notice less the notice given, divided by the free-cancellation notice;
- notice of at least a quarter (0.25) but less than half of the free-cancellation notice multiplies the visit value by 0.75;
- notice of less than a quarter of the free-cancellation notice leaves the visit value whole.

The club visit value is the club's price paid divided by its included visits.

**In hours for Groom Club Monthly (free-cancellation notice of 24 hours)**

| Full hours of notice recorded on the cancellation | Treatment of the visit value |
|---|---|
| 12 to 23 | multiplied by 24 less the notice, divided by 24 |
| 6 to 11 | multiplied by 0.75 |
| 0 to 5 | whole |

**Input — judgement — output (hypothetical club visit value of 87.99)**

| Notice | Band | Charge after the notice treatment |
|---|---|---|
| 18 hours | half or more | 87.99 multiplied by 6, divided by 24: 21.9975 before the final rounding |
| 12 hours | exactly half, so prorated | 87.99 multiplied by 12, divided by 24: 43.995 |
| 11 hours | quarter to half | 87.99 multiplied by 0.75: 65.9925 |
| 6 hours | exactly a quarter | 65.9925 |
| 5 hours | under a quarter | 87.99 |
